agyos_skill.intent: Improve a prompt for a defined task by setting output criteria, testing representative cases, and comparing results. Measure quality on that task; do not assume fixed gains.
agyos_skill.instructions: Improve a prompt for a defined task by setting output criteria, testing representative cases, and comparing results. Measure quality on that task; do not assume fixed gains. - Working on prompt optimization tasks or workflows - Needing guidance, best practices, or checklists for prompt optimization - The task is unrelated to prompt optimization - You need a different domain or tool outside this scope Transform basic instructions into production-ready prompts. Prompt changes have task-dependent effects. Compare candidate prompts against representative cases and report measured outcomes; do not assume a general accuracy or cost gain. $ARGUMENTS - Clarify goals, constraints, and required inputs. - Apply relevant best practices and validate outcomes. - Provide actionable steps and verification. - If detailed examples are required, open `resources/implementation-playbook.md`. - `resources/implementation-playbook.md` for detailed patterns and examples. - Use this skill only when the task clearly matches the scope described above. - Do not treat the output as a substitute for environment-specific validation, testing, or expert review. - Stop and ask for clarification if required inputs, permissions, safety boundaries, or success criteria are missing.
